frequency_question: What proportion of Senate nominations for major agency heads clear the committee and floor confirmation stage within a tight multi-week window when standard advance signals are present?
membership_rule: Includes all cabinet and major agency head nominations (such as FDA, EPA, FDA equivalent) in the past three presidential administrations that reached the formal nomination stage; excludes routine judicial promotions and minor board positions.
coverage_note: 5 named key agency nomination instances representing high-profile health regulator confirmations; believed to cover the relevant modern subset of contested public health nominations.
known_gaps: Excludes minor sub-agency appointments that bypass major floor friction.
skeleton: Recent presidential administrations times key health/regulatory agency nominations evaluated for fast-track confirmation success within 30 days of initial committee movement.
multiplier: 3 recent administrations * 2 major agency nominations per cycle = 6 baseline instances, adjusted for strict calendar deadlines.
validity_reason: Senate confirmation norms and procedural rules remain stable through the current congressional term, expiring with the turnover of the congressional session.
